description: Ba₆Na₂Nb₂P₂O₁₇ crystallizes in the trigonal P̅3m1 space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent NbO₆ octahedra, corners with three equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra, and faces with five BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 3°. There are three shorter (2.24 Å) and three longer (2.44 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent Ba sites. In the first Ba site, Ba is bonded to twelve O atoms to form distorted BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with three equivalent BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with three equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, faces with four equivalent NbO₆ octahedra, and  a faceface with one PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Ba-O bond distances ranging from 2.86-3.26 Å. In the second Ba site, Ba is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten O atoms. There are a spread of Ba-O bond distances ranging from 2.65-2.98 Å. In the third Ba site, Ba is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form distorted BaO₆ cuboctahedra that share corners with six equivalent BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, corners with six equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra, and faces with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. All Ba-O bond lengths are 2.84 Å. In the fourth Ba site, Ba is bonded to twelve O atoms to form BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with six equivalent BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and faces with six equivalent NbO₆ octahedra. There are six shorter (2.93 Å) and six longer (2.96 Å) Ba-O bond lengths. Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with three equivalent NbO₆ octahedra, and faces with seven BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-3°. There are three shorter (1.93 Å) and three longer (2.13 Å) Nb-O bond lengths. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent BaO₆ cuboctahedra, corners with three equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and  a faceface with one BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 17°. There is one shorter (1.52 Å) and three longer (1.56 Å) P-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to one Na, four Ba, and one Nb atom to form distorted OBa₄NaNb octahedra that share corners with fourteen OBa₄NaNb octahedra, edges with two equivalent OBa₄Nb₂ octahedra, and faces with six OBa₄NaNb octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-63°. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to one Na, four Ba, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to four Ba and two equivalent Nb atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing OBa₄Nb₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-60°. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Ba and one P atom.
